scope: V30 task-learning stage coverage, not a whole-goal completion certificate

rows.design: Real task supervision with source-isolated images and train-only appearance perturbations
rows.implemented_scope: 1272 real images, 13 source groups, 14642 nonempty task annotations; 674 images have >=15 instances
rows.not_proved: A count of >=15 does not itself prove physical mutual occlusion; prior synthetic dense assets are not used by this V30 task stage

rows.design: Keep original task RLE, ignore unknown ownership and semantic labels, separate train/dev/test
rows.implemented_scope: 21111 known normal queries; train/dev source groups disjoint; test not read
rows.not_proved: Real named parts, complete shape and physical visibility remain unknown

rows.design: Pretrained multiscale RGB encoder-decoder with pixel skips and native full-canvas residual
rows.implemented_scope: 256 context crop, six scales, source-equivalent network, exact native zero-start at full640
rows.not_proved: Complete normal utility contradicted at current scope: Mask AP43.359584,497/2126 damages; architecture usefulness and named semantics not established.

rows.design: Persistent conditional model parameters and image-specific continuous object state
rows.not_proved: 512 state coordinates do not imply named parts, full anatomy or disentangled semantics

rows.design: No mandatory explicit dictionary in the first task-learning stage
rows.implemented_scope: Object knowledge may be carried by shared task-trained parameters; no fictitious vocabulary slots
rows.not_proved: Whether a later explicit real-exemplar memory adds value is untested

rows.design: Normal output identity, box, coarse mask and RGB condition the current object
rows.implemented_scope: Normal API has no query GT; source-coordinate and CPU cache parity checked
rows.not_proved: No semantic standing/part prototype match is claimed

rows.design: Named pose/part composition requires known semantic anchors after task representation is useful
rows.implemented_scope: Unknown real semantic targets are not negative examples
rows.not_proved: Pose compatibility, named parts and compositional reconstruction are not trained or accepted in V30

rows.design: Keep instance identity; use image context without forcing all task masks to be mutually exclusive
rows.implemented_scope: Per-output reconstruction with preserved detection fields and original RLE semantics
rows.not_proved: Explicit physical object-to-object/fixture occlusion reasoning remains unaccepted

rows.design: Image-conditioned discrete denoising from the normal coarse mask
rows.implemented_scope: Six fixed steps; each predicts a residual relative to the native base rather than cumulatively adding six residuals
rows.not_proved: Complete normal utility contradicted at current scope: Mask AP43.359584,497/2126 damages; architecture usefulness and named semantics not established.

rows.design: Use current RGB sampling and multiscale skips for task boundaries
rows.implemented_scope: Pixel-center nearest-exact labels, CPU bilinear RGB with one-thread quantization parity
rows.not_proved: Complete normal utility contradicted at current scope: Mask AP43.359584,497/2126 damages; architecture usefulness and named semantics not established.

rows.design: YOLO provides frozen localization; a separate task-trained model edits the final mask
rows.implemented_scope: Zero-start full native mask exact; native parameters excluded from training; all432 normal outputs and frozen box/score/identity verified
rows.not_proved: Complete normal utility contradicted at current scope: Mask AP43.359584,497/2126 damages; architecture usefulness and named semantics not established.

rows.design: Fixed six-step final EMA with no dev-selected replacement or threshold search

rows.not_proved: Training-time zero-start does not guarantee trained success preservation
